args: Write-Host '📊 Phase 89: System Status' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '═' * 60; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '1️⃣ PostgreSQL' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $pg = docker exec phase66-postgres psql -U user -d legal -c 'SELECT source, COUNT(*) as total FROM raw_error_embeddings GROUP BY source;' 2>&1; Write-Host $pg; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '2️⃣ Redis' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $redis = docker exec phase66-redis redis-cli DBSIZE 2>&1; Write-Host "   Keys: $redis"; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '3️⃣ Qdrant' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $qdrant = curl -s 'http://localhost:6333/collections/phase89_code_units' 2>&1 | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "   phase89_code_units: $($qdrant.result.points_count) points"; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '4️⃣ CUDA' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $cuda = & 'C:\Users\james\Videos\deeds-web-app\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -c 'import torch; print(torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if torch.cuda.is_available() else "Not available")' 2>&1; Write-Host "   GPU: $cuda"; Write-Host ''

tasks.label: 🛡️ Phase 89: Safeguard Check
args: Write-Host '🛡️ Phase 89: Safeguard Check' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '═' * 60; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Checking for destructive operations...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ''; $dangerous = @('DROP TABLE', 'TRUNCATE', 'DELETE FROM', 'docker rm', 'docker-compose down', 'rm -rf'); $files = Get-ChildItem -Path scripts -Filter 'phase89-*.mjs' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $safe = $true; foreach ($file in $files) { $content = Get-Content $file.FullName -Raw; foreach ($pattern in $dangerous) { if ($content -match [regex]::Escape($pattern)) { Write-Host "⚠️  Found '$pattern' in $($file.Name)" -ForegroundColor Red; $safe = $false } } }; if ($safe) { Write-Host '✅ All Phase 89 scripts are SAFE (no destructive patterns found)' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '⚠️  Review flagged files before running' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host ''
tasks.detail: Phase 89: Scan scripts for destructive operations (DROP, DELETE, rm -rf, etc.)
